topic: Types of oxygen systems, oxygen storage, regulators and masks
syllabus_extract: Types of oxygen systems, oxygen storage, regulators and masks
specific_objectives: 17.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the need of oxygen systems, types of systems, working principles of components.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification of oxygen storage types, regulator components, and mask assemblies using L & Ds and IB; Safety precautions regarding oxygen purity and pressure limits; Instructor supervision of component identification.
intro_questions: Why is an oxygen system essential for aircrew at high altitudes?
What are the primary hazards associated with oxygen systems?
Can you list three common methods used to store oxygen in aircraft?
